note: 'some astrologers came forward and maliciously accused the Jews' (Dan 3:8); the charge that follows names 'some Jews you have appointed to manage the province of Babylon' (Dan 3:12).

'wanting to learn the real reason Paul was accused by the Jews' (Acts 22:30). The verse says 'the Jews'; the nearest verse that names who seized Paul is Acts 21:27, 'some Jews from the province of Asia', and 22:30 does not say the accusers were only those.
scope_party: some Jews from the province of Asia

note: At Caesarea 'the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing many serious charges that they could not prove' (Acts 25:7).
scope_party: the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem

note: 'Your accuser is Moses, in whom you have put your hope.' (John 5:45). The verse says 'you'; Jesus answers those named in John 5:16-18, and the accusation is a future one before the Father rather than an episode the narrative reports.
scope_party: the Jews tried all the harder to kill Him

note: 'the men who had falsely accused Daniel were brought and thrown into the den of lions' (Dan 6:24); the charge itself is at 6:13, that Daniel shows no regard for the king or for his decree.
